warnings.message: Mosaic node "root" emits an overlay chain 28 deep (threshold 20) with inline masks riding it. Past ~25 nested overlays ffmpeg SILENTLY degrades inline masks — shapes collapse to their bounding box, glyph masks tofu; no error is raised. Tiles stayed off the grid sheet because their rects overlap. Consider splitting the layout into nested sub-mosaics, or removing per-cell blend/enable/opacity/position expressions so tiles can lower onto the xstack sheet.
